approved_now_count.description: Operators approvable now on a time-boxed grant.

binding_policy_clause.description: The operative clause cited to refuse the conflicting and unattested asks.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

cost_of_delay_usd.description: Incremental cost of the expedited-re-attestation escalation path.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

duplicate_request_count.description: Requests consolidated to an earlier open request.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

exception_required_count.description: Operators blocked on a lapsed attestation, recoverable via screening.

excluded_quantity.description: operator requests blocked on a lapsed attestation, a duplicate, a missing attestation, or a segregation-of-duties conflict

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Sentinel's confirmed standard and expedited re-attestation dates on RQ-58001.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for today's restricted SCADA operator batch.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: REQUEST.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental spend of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing grant_operator_cohort, expedite_reattestation_via_tier2, grant_all_despite_sod.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

refused_outright_count.description: Requests refused outright (a segregation-of-duties conflict and a missing attestation).

source_quantity.description: operator requests that need a coverage decision after removing duplicates and refusals (approve-now plus exception-eligible)

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Sentinel's confirmed standard and expedited re-attestation dates on RQ-58001.

supported_quantity.description: operator requests approvable now on a time-boxed grant under the v5 standard

time_boxed_grant_days.description: Time box the operative restricted clause allows.

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the primary state change may persist.

facts.rubric: Located RES-SCADA-OP using immutable identifiers and preserved effective standard v5: resource code scada-operate resolves to RES-SCADA-OP; the scada-config role (RES-SCADA-CFG) is a different resource and domain.
facts.statement: AGR-0008: resource code scada-operate resolves to RES-SCADA-OP; the scada-config role (RES-SCADA-CFG) is a different resource and domain; the effective standard is v5.

facts.rubric: Applied the operative clause and the request batch to establish 4 REQUEST for operator requests that need a coverage decision after removing duplicates and refusals (approve-now plus exception-eligible), with control date 2026-05-21.
facts.statement: The operative clause and the request batch establish operator requests that need a coverage decision after removing duplicates and refusals (approve-now plus exception-eligible) = 4 REQUEST: seven pending requests, of which one is a duplicate and two are refusals, leave four coverage decisions and a grant covering the three eligible now. The control date is 2026-05-21 (the substation maintenance window opens 2026-05-21 and the operators must be provisioned before it).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 7 observed less 4 excluded to 3 eligible REQUEST for operator requests approvable now on a time-boxed grant under the v5 standard.
facts.statement: three operators hold the current SEC-ATT-2026 attestation; one lapsed, one holds a config conflict, and one has no attestation; eligibility requires netting the blocked and duplicate requests rather than trusting the raw queue.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-05-14 expedited screening readiness for expedite_reattestation_via_tier2, then separately derived its 2026-05-14 operating outcome under the v5 restricted clause and the signed approval scope instead of treating a vendor promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Sentinel's confirmed standard and expedited re-attestation dates on RQ-58001: Sentinel RQ-58001 confirms standard re-attestation 2026-05-15 and expedited 2026-05-13 (+USD 230); eligibility is the next business day; a vendor confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied approver review windows that do not displace protected blocks to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked review windows.
facts.statement: approver review windows that do not displace protected blocks: the first free review window on or after 2026-05-18 is APR-1 AM on 2026-05-18; protected and blocked review windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-AG-0108 only to grant_operator_cohort and RES-SCADA-OP; kept expedite_reattestation_via_tier2 outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-AG-0108 covers a grant for up to 3 requests on the restricted console; the expedite fee and any conflict waiver need the risk committee. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize expedite_reattestation_via_tier2.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected grant_operator_cohort: it is the best currently authorized disposition that satisfies the v5 restricted clause and the signed approval scope.
facts.statement: the substation maintenance window opens 2026-05-21 and the operators must be provisioned before it; a faster or broader disposition has value only if it stays inside the v5 restricted clause and the signed approval scope.

options.consequence: grant operator cohort provisions the 3 attested operators on a 30-day restricted grant and routes the lapsed operator to standard re-attestation, clearing on the 2026-05-18 review window, at no incremental cost.
options.label: grant_operator_cohort: outcome 2026-05-18, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: expedite re-attestation via tier-2 clears the lapsed operator by 2026-05-13 for USD 230, but the expedite fee and the tier-2 exception need the risk committee, which AP-AG-0108 does not carry.
options.label: expedite_reattestation_via_tier2: outcome 2026-05-14, incremental cost USD 230, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

options.consequence: grant all despite the segregation-of-duties conflict would admit the config holder as an operator immediately, but the v5 standard refuses that conflict outright, so the evidence does not support it.
options.label: grant_all_despite_sod: outcome 2026-05-12, incremental cost USD 0, FAILS_CURRENT_CONTROL
